summary: PlacementRequest is a core entity in HSPnet, managing requests for placements, supporting validation, workflow routing, business rules, status management, linking/unlinking, and cohort handling.
purpose: Facilitate creation, validation, management, and workflow routing of placement requests between agencies, departments, programs, and cohort groups. Support business logic for access, linking, archiving, deletion, status filtering, and emailing.

entities.name: PlacementRequestDestination
entities.description: Destination placement request, includes properties for agency, department, program, site, service, destination, course, type, discipline, subdiscipline, dates, and related short names.

entities.name: PR
entities.description: Placement Request, includes ID and related properties for agency, department, program, course, type, dates, receiving agency, site, service, and destination.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Validation Workflow
steps: Check user access: site, service, destination (userType, agency).
Skip check if values are blank/zero.
Validate placement request via stored procedure 'PlacementRequestSearch'.
Return parent CFO flag if applicable.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Key Info Fill
steps: Load placement request key info via procedure 'PlacementRequestKeyInfo'.
Populate entity with fields from database reader.
Close reader and indicate success.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Linking and Unlinking
steps: Link PRs via 'PlacementRequestLink' stored procedure.
Check for SQL errors, report result.
Unlink PR via 'PlacementRequestUnLink' stored procedure.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Status Filter Retrieval
steps: Fetch allowed status codes using 'StatusCodeFilterList' stored procedure based on userType.
Aggregate comma-separated status codes from database reader.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Shared Cohort Check
steps: Check cohort status using 'QESCheckOldRuleCohort'.
If SharedCohort field is non-zero, flag as shared.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Deletion & Archive
steps: Check deletion status using 'PlacementRequestSearchDeleted'.
Check archive status using 'PlacementRequestSearchArchived'.
Return boolean flag for status.

workflows.name: PlacementRequest Email Subject Caching Workflow
steps: Check short subject flag. If set, compose short subject.
Otherwise, retrieve from cache or build new subject from PR details.
Cache subject for repeated use.
Return final email subject.

business_rules: User must have access to site/service/destination to validate PlacementRequest (unless blank).
Parent CFO flag is set if UseCallForOffers is true and CFOWorksheetGroupID is zero.
Status filtering is dependent on userType.
Linking/Unlinking PRs is permitted with session and PR list/ID.
validations: SiteID, ServiceID, and DestinationID must not be zero for access checks.
Database reader must return a row for valid PR.
ID checks for deletion, archive, and shared cohort status must be non-zero.
calculations: HSPnetTermStart: determines term start based on month (Jan-Apr, May-Aug, Sep-Dec).
HSPnetTermEnd: determines term end based on month (Jan-Apr, May-Aug, Sep-Dec).
conditions: If userType is 1 or 2 and not NIS/IRP agency, perform site/service/destination checks.
If UseCallForOffers is true and CFOWorksheetGroupID is zero, set ParentCFO true.
system_behavior: PlacementRequest can be archived, deleted, linked, unlinked, validated, and checked for shared cohorts.
PR email subjects are cached for efficiency.
Status filters and lookups use stored procedures.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for context, parameters, and cache.
Sites, Services, Destinations for access checks.
Resources for localized messages and subject lines.
exceptions: SQL error during linking is flagged and message is replaced.
If no access is granted, validation fails.
